BARQ / 01
A complete freight solution

Road Freight

Barq's ground freight division is the backbone of Pakistan's domestic supply chain. We operate a modern, GPS-tracked fleet of trucks including flatbeds, reefers, and enclosed carriers — connecting manufacturers, distributors, and retailers across all major cities and industrial zones.

  • Fleet of 200+ trucks including full-truck-load (FTL) and less-than-truckload (LTL) options
  • GPS real-time tracking on every vehicle
  • Dedicated express lanes: Lahore–Karachi, Karachi–Islamabad, and Peshawar corridors
  • Local last-mile delivery integrated with our long-haul network
  • Specialized flatbeds for oversized and industrial cargo
  • Door-to-door pickup and delivery with digital POD (Proof of Delivery)

Coverage
Lahore · Karachi · Islamabad · Faisalabad · Multan · Peshawar · Quetta · Gujranwala

BARQ / 02
A complete freight solution

Air Freight

When speed is non-negotiable, Barq Air Freight delivers. We partner with major international airlines and domestic carriers to offer competitive, reliable air cargo solutions for time-sensitive shipments — from urgent documents to full charter loads.

  • Direct agreements with major airlines for priority cargo space
  • Airport-to-airport and door-to-door air services
  • Coverage: Jinnah International (KHI), Allama Iqbal (LHE), Islamabad International (ISB)
  • International destinations across Middle East, Europe, UK, USA, and Asia
  • Dangerous goods handling (IATA compliant)
  • Same-day booking available for urgent consignments

Coverage
Karachi (KHI) · Lahore (LHE) · Islamabad (ISB) · Dubai (DXB) · London (LHR) · New York (JFK)

Request a quote
BARQ / 03
A complete freight solution

Ocean Freight

Barq Ocean Freight offers comprehensive sea cargo services for importers and exporters. We handle Full Container Load (FCL) and Less-than-Container-Load (LCL) shipments through Karachi Port and Port Qasim, connecting Pakistan to ports across the globe.

  • FCL: 20ft, 40ft standard, high-cube, and reefer containers
  • LCL consolidation for smaller shipments at competitive rates
  • Weekly sailings to Middle East, Europe, Far East, and Americas
  • Pre-clearance and port documentation management
  • Hazardous cargo handling with IMO compliance
  • Freight insurance available for all ocean shipments

Coverage
Karachi Port · Port Qasim · Dubai (Jebel Ali) · Colombo · Singapore · Rotterdam

Request a quote
BARQ / 04
A complete freight solution

Custom Clearance

Navigating Pakistan's customs regulations can be complex. Barq's licensed customs clearance team simplifies the process — handling all documentation, duty calculations, HS code classification, and regulatory compliance so your cargo moves without delays.

  • Licensed under Pakistan Customs (FBR) for all ports and dry ports
  • Expert HS code classification and duty optimization
  • Import/Export documentation: B/L, commercial invoices, packing lists, certificates of origin
  • SRO and exemption certificate management
  • ATA Carnet handling for temporary imports
  • Post-clearance audit support and dispute resolution

Coverage
Karachi Port · Port Qasim · Lahore Dry Port · Islamabad Dry Port · Torkham Border · Wagah Border

Request a quote

A complete freight solution

Project Handling

Barq Project Handling is a dedicated division for cargo that goes beyond standard freight. We manage the end-to-end logistics of heavy machinery, industrial equipment, power plant components, and infrastructure cargo — requiring specialized equipment, engineering, and government coordination.

  • Heavy-lift and oversized cargo: up to 500 metric tons
  • Multi-modal project logistics: sea + road + crane operations
  • Route surveys, police escorts, and government NOC management
  • Specialized trailers: modular, lowbed, extendable deck
  • On-site project management and installation support
  • Case studies: Power plant relocation, mining equipment, wind turbines

Coverage
Countrywide · Cross-border (Afghanistan, Iran) · Port-to-site delivery

Warehousing

Barq's warehousing division operates state-of-the-art storage facilities across key trade hubs in China. Through our sister company Yiwu Barq Trading & Co., LTD, we offer end-to-end warehousing solutions — from goods receipt and quality inspection to consolidation and export — bridging Chinese manufacturers directly to your supply chain.

  • Modern warehousing facilities in Yiwu, Shanghai, and Guangzhou
  • Goods receiving, quality inspection, and labelling services
  • Cargo consolidation for cost-effective FCL/LCL exports
  • Direct export corridors from China to Pakistan (sea & air)
  • Inventory management with real-time stock reporting
  • Cross-docking and transshipment services available

Coverage
China (Nationwide)

Talk to Barq
01What types of cargo does Barq handle?+
We handle all types including general cargo, temperature-controlled freight, hazardous materials (with proper documentation), oversized project cargo, and high-value goods. Our multi-modal network covers road, air, and sea.
02Do you offer door-to-door delivery?+
Yes. Our end-to-end logistics solutions include pickup from the origin, all transit handling, customs clearance, and final-mile delivery to the destination address — domestically and internationally.
03How do I track my shipment?+
Contact the Barq Cargo support team with your shipment reference for status updates and delivery information.
04What is your expertise in temperature-controlled logistics?+
Barq operates a dedicated reefer fleet capable of maintaining temperatures from -25°C to +25°C. We specialize in perishables including fresh produce, pharmaceuticals, and dairy products across domestic and export corridors.
05How does custom clearance work?+
Our licensed customs brokers handle all documentation, duty calculations, HS code classification, and regulatory compliance on your behalf. We work across all major ports including Karachi, Lahore Dry Port, and Islamabad airport.
06Can Barq handle large project cargo?+
Absolutely. Our project handling division specializes in heavy-lift, oversized, and multi-piece cargo requiring specialized equipment, route surveys, and government NOCs. Contact us for a detailed project assessment.
